cohort: 60 pregnant women with a diagnosis of neurologic disorders admitted to the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department at St John's Medical College, St John's National Academy of Health Sciences (SJNAHS), Bengaluru, Karnataka, India between January 2016 and December 2018.
finding: A multidisciplinary approach in a tertiary care center improves both maternal and fetal outcomes in pregnant women with neurological disorders.
mod_finding: 46.6% of women had a cesarean section, and 45% had a vaginal delivery.
